name: What types of materials are used for door casing repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used for door casing repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials used for door casing repair include various types of wood, such as pine, oak, or poplar, chosen to match existing trim. Medium-density fiberboard (MDF) is a popular, cost-effective option, particularly for painted finishes, due to its smooth surface and stability. For areas prone to moisture, composite or PVC casing can be used for its water-resistant properties. Wood putty or epoxy fillers are utilized for patching smaller imperfections before sanding and finishing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials include pine, oak, poplar, or MDF for wood-based trim. Water-prone areas may use composite or PVC. Wood putty or epoxy fillers are used for minor patches.
